title: Seagrove Beach "Bonita By Mar" 80 Montigo Avenue
h1: Seagrove Beach "Bonita By Mar" 80 Montigo Avenue
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach- 4-minute walk to the beach- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $40 per day- 6 adult bikes- Low Speed Vehicle- Golf Cart- In-home elevator- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Blissful, balmy days await at Bonita By Mar, a contemporary Seagrove Beach home. Boasting 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and 2 half baths, this 3-level home comfortably accommodates 22 guests. Enjoy 3,965 square feet of luxury living, a private pool, and walkable beach access—only 3 minutes away!A spacious front porch with a cushioned swing sets the peaceful tone the moment guests arrive. Venture inside to an open great room designed in a soothing, beach-inspired aesthetic of pale woods and muted colors. The gorgeous kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and overlooks the living and dining spaces for seamless conversation. Curl up on the soft sectional for a laid-back evening watching the Smart TV with friends and family. Beneath a beaded chandelier is an 8-seat table, with additional seating for 5 at the breakfast bar. Enjoy the temperate weather on the back porch’s cushioned seating or in the enclosed backyard, outfitted with a private pool, chaise lounges, a grill, and a firepit. When bedtime arrives, there is a guest bedroom with a king bed, a private bathroom, and a Smart TV on this level, as well as a laundry room for convenience.Take the in-home elevator or stairs to the second level to find 1 bunk room with 2 queen-over-queen beds and 3 lovely guest bedrooms—the first guest bedroom has 2 queen beds, and the other 2 guest bedrooms each have a king bed.On the top level, a second living space with a queen sleeper sofa, armchair, Smart TV, beverage fridge, and coffee maker offers room for the group to spread out. Step onto the secluded balcony to sip drinks at the round 6-seat table or at the arrangement of comfy patio chairs. The beautifully appointed primary bedroom with a plush king bed and a luxe private bathroom is on this floor.Discover an idyllic Seagrove Beach getaway at Bonita By Mar. There’s parking for 6 vehicles and 6 complimentary adult bikes for guests who prefer slow-paced exploring. Santa Clara Regional Beach Access is a 5-minute walk. Head south on Montigo Avenue, turn right onto E. County Highway 30A, and the beach access will be on the left. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 22):FIRST FLOOR: -Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Utilizes Common Area Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate-Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper SofaAs of August 2025, there is construction in the vicinity of this home.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seagrove Beach "Bonita By Mar" 80 Montigo Avenue Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-221328 Bedrooms 6 Beds 10 Sleeps 22 Full Baths 5 Half Baths 2 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach - 4-minute walk to the beach - Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $40 per day - 6 adult bikes - Low Speed Vehicle- Golf Cart - In-home elevator - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Blissful, balmy days await at Bonita By Mar, a contemporary Seagrove Beach home. Boasting 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and 2 half baths, this 3-level home comfortably accommodates 22 guests. Enjoy 3,965 square feet of luxury living, a private pool, and walkable beach access—only 3 minutes away! A spacious front porch with a cushioned swing sets the peaceful tone the moment guests arrive. Venture inside to an open great room designed in a soothing, beach-inspired aesthetic of pale woods and muted colors. The gorgeous kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and overlooks the living and dining spaces for seamless conversation. Curl up on the soft sectional for a laid-back evening watching the Smart TV with friends and family. Beneath a beaded chandelier is an 8-seat table, with additional seating for 5 at the breakfast bar. Enjoy the temperate weather on the back porch’s cushioned seating or in the enclosed backyard, outfitted with a private pool, chaise lounges, a grill, and a firepit. When bedtime arrives, there is a guest bedroom with a king bed, a private bathroom, and a Smart TV on this level, as well as a laundry room for convenience. Take the in-home elevator or stairs to the second level to find 1 bunk room with 2 queen-over-queen beds and 3 lovely guest bedrooms—the first guest bedroom has 2 queen beds, and the other 2 guest bedrooms each have a king bed. On the top level, a second living space with a queen sleeper sofa, armchair, Smart TV, beverage fridge, and coffee maker offers room for the group to spread out. Step onto the secluded balcony to sip drinks at the round 6-seat table or at the arrangement of comfy patio chairs. The beautifully appointed primary bedroom with a plush king bed and a luxe private bathroom is on this floor. Discover an idyllic Seagrove Beach getaway at Bonita By Mar. There’s parking for 6 vehicles and 6 complimentary adult bikes for guests who prefer slow-paced exploring. Santa Clara Regional Beach Access is a 5-minute walk. Head south on Montigo Avenue, turn right onto E. County Highway 30A, and the beach access will be on the left. Book today!
